adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `createEvent` now accepts an optional `externalId` (CalendarManager) and EventManager now stores `externalCalendarId` from `result.externalId` (replacing the previous `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the legacy branch for destinations without `credentialId` still does `await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))` (no externalId passed). Since CalendarManager only propagates `externalId` into the `EventResult` when it is provided, this path will yield `result.externalId === undefined`, so stored references will lose `externalCalendarId`, which can break later update/delete targeting.
